title: Idolizing Armstrong after five years with him
summary: Randolph can imitate Armstrong's voice and horn, was with him nearly five years and ranks him just behind God and his wife.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And that gravel voice Louis got. But you know, I can imitate Louis so -- and the way he blows his trumpet, his singing and his talking. Well, I should, I was with the man right up on five years and I idolized the man.
It was Jesus first, and I guess it was a tossup between Louis and my wife. Because I know Louis was right in there.
I think that's a good note to end on.
